signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for a search engine purpose-built for AI agents.
Talk to customers constantly (agent builders, AI labs, enterprises) and turn what you hear into product decisions.
Solve our cold start: design the product hooks and feedback loops that take us from limited data to 10M+ diverse daily agent queries improving retrieval quality.
Define and drive the KPIs that matter: queries/day, retention, API integrations.
